title: albizia dalatensis
intro: Albizia dalatensis, commonly known as Dalat Albizia or Dalat Siris, is a species of flowering plant in the pea family, Fabaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, cough, and respiratory issues, as well as supporting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Albizia dalatensis are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation and exhibit antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and the treatment of various infections. The bioactive constituents of Albizia dalatensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its health benefits and therapeutic actions.
